BiblicalUsage: Hathul is derision, open mockery, and it appears once, in Job's complaint. In Job 17:2 he says there are mockers with him, and his eye continues in their provocation, watching them laugh while he suffers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job names the worst part of suffering plainly: the pain is bad enough, and the mockery of the people watching is worse.
